title: A bioavailable GPX4 inhibitor for ferroptosis induction in vivo and tumor suppression
title_zh: 一种可口服的GPX4抑制剂用于体内诱导铁死亡并抑制肿瘤
abstract: Ferroptosis is implicated in multiple human diseases, but the lack of bioavailable inducers has limited its physiological study and therapeutic translation. Here, we report KY0418, a selective covalent inhibitor of glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) featuring an isourea warhead, with high plasma stability and broad tissue distribution after oral dosing in mice. KY0418 specifically targets GPX4SeCys46 to induce ferroptosis hallmarks in human and mouse cancer cell lines, with greater selectivity than existing inhibitors. In a standardizable acute-liver-injury mouse model, KY0418 triggers ferroptotic ultrastructural changes matching those of established inducers, and systemic administration remodels tissue metabolism and generates hydroxyl radicals detectable by a chemiluminescent probe. Subcutaneous tumors from different cancers exhibited variable responses to KY0418 treatment, from no effect to about 70% growth inhibition, but KY0418 consistently eradicated circulating tumor cells and suppressed metastasis across multiple cancer models. These findings position KY0418 as a tool for advancing in vivo ferroptosis research and its clinical translation.
abstract_zh: 铁死亡与多种人类疾病相关，但缺乏可口服的诱导剂限制了其生理学研究和临床转化。本文报道了KY0418，一种具有异酰胺 warhead 的选择性共价抑制剂，靶向谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4），在小鼠口服给药后具有高血浆稳定性和广泛的组织分布。KY0418 通过特异性结合 GPX4 的 SeCys46 位点，诱导人类和小鼠癌细胞系的铁死亡特征，且比现有抑制剂具有更高的选择性。在可标准化的急性肝损伤小鼠模型中，KY0418 触发与已知诱导剂相匹配的铁死亡超微结构变化，系统给药可重塑组织代谢并产生可被化学发光探针检测到的羟基自由基。不同癌种的皮下肿瘤对 KY0418 的反应差异显著，从无效到约 70% 的生长抑制，但 KY0418 一致消除循环肿瘤细胞并抑制多种癌症模型的转移。上述结果将 KY0418 定位为推进体内铁死亡研究及其临床转化的工具。
